gloss: A hand-held probe that gives a tiny electrical pulse; when it touches the facial nerve the face twitches. An instrument, not anatomy.
role: During the operation the surgeon can touch a tissue with a small stimulator: if it is the nerve, the face twitches. The patient is kept from being paralysed so this can be seen.
matters: A monitor that signals when the nerve is touched lowers the chance of weakness straight after surgery; whether it changes lasting weakness is not shown.
